short: Zeta is zero-free to the right of three quarters

lean.name: Formalism.B.ZetaQuarterPowerCorollary
lean.plain: Zeta is zero-free to the right of three quarters
lean.note: This proposed implication requires data for a CM type and its dual at every sufficiently large scale, with the number of lifts of order x^(1/4) and bounds on the bad primes and averaging error. Its conclusion is ζ(s) ≠ 0 for Re(s) > 3/4, and the implication is outside the final dependency cone.
